record.field: Congratulations from Aktiv! You've Won the Odoo Days Contest.

field.name: body_html
field.div:
Hello ,
We are thrilled to inform you that you have emerged as a winner in the Odoo Days Contest hosted by Aktiv Software. Congratulations on this remarkable achievement! Your dedication and contributions to the Odoo community have truly shone, and we are excited to reward your efforts.
To claim your prize, please visit Booth A1 at the Odoo Community Days event venue. Our representatives will be available to assist you with the prize collection process. Kindly bring your identification and the email notification with you for verification purposes.
If you have any questions or require further information, please feel free to reply to this email or contact our team at hr@aktivsoftware.com.
Once again, congratulations on your well-deserved victory! We look forward to meeting you at Booth 35.
Best Regards,
